input.quote: 2. TERM. The term of this Agreement shall begin on the date hereof and shall continue until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6 hereof.
input.rationale: There is no auto-renewal mechanic anywhere in the Agreement (no "renew" language, no renewal term, and no price-uplift or rate-increase provisions). Instead, § 2 creates an evergreen term that continues until terminated under § 6, and § 6(a) lets either party — including us — terminate for any or no reason on fifteen (15) days' notice whenever no Statement of Work is outstanding. That structure is at least as favourable to us as the preferred position (no automatic renewal, exit on well under 30 days' notice, no committed multi-year renewal, no unilateral price escalation), so there is nothing to redline. Noted only for completeness: because there is no renewal pricing mechanic, fee changes would need to be agreed in each Statement of Work; if we later add renewal terms we should carry in the CPI/3% uplift cap.
